change: Only a first full GET response with no queued follow-up and a request decoder at a complete message boundary may be intercepted. Pipelined or partially received requests remain observation-only.

failures.Name: Later pipelined response cannot claim the original stream
Queued follow-up request prevents first-response takeover
Partial follow-up headers prevent first-response takeover
Unfinished GET request body prevents response takeover

acceptance: Exact original request and both response bytes over a real loopback relay despite an affirmative decision
Safe single-request interception still stops parsing buffered bytes
limitations: Non-elevated core tests; no driver-enabled gateway run.
No durable response ownership or automatic takeover workflow added.
